cases.question: Will U.S. CPI be above 3.0% on September 11, 2026?
cases.criteria: This market resolves YES if the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reports CPI above 3.0% on September 11, 2026 at 08:30 EDT. The first published release controls.

cases.question: Will the Federal Reserve cut interest rates by the end of September 2026?
cases.criteria: This market resolves YES if the Federal Reserve announces an interest rate cut by the end of September 2026, based on official Federal Reserve reporting.
cases.rerun_criteria: This market resolves YES if the Federal Reserve announces an interest rate cut by September 30, 2026 at 23:59 EDT, based on the official Federal Open Market Committee statement.
